title: Special Executive Masters Program In Media and Entertainment
description: The SEMP in Media and Entertainment is a specialized course designed to equip professionals with advanced media and entertainment industry knowledge and skills.
longDescription: The Special Executive Masters Program (SEMP) in Media and Entertainment aims to provide professionals with a comprehensive understanding of the industry by combining theoretical knowledge with hands-on practical experience. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Media and Entertainment allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: The Special Executive Masters Program (SEMP) in Media and Entertainment offers a comprehensive curriculum that blends media expertise with business acumen to prepare professionals for leadership roles in the entertainment industry. Course Details: Management Information System: Examines the design and implementation of computer-based systems that help organizations manage data and information effectively. Media and Communication Industry: Explores the dynamics and structure of the media sector. Events Planning and Management: Provides insights into organizing, coordinating, and managing events, from concept to execution, focusing on industry best practices. Operations Management: Addresses the efficient planning, scheduling, and control of production processes to optimize resources and deliver quality outcomes. Strategic Management: Discusses formulating, implementing, and evaluating cross-functional decisions that enable organizations to achieve long-term objectives. Business Research Methods: Introduces techniques for conducting rigorous business research, including data collection, analysis, and interpretation, to support strategic decision-making. Assessment: GP Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in media and entertainment and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There are no Visa Requirements for this Course as its an Online Course.

modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ ability to prepare for various types of academically based management research through the development and design of a research proposal. Learners will develop a critical understanding of the philosophical, practical and ethical concepts of research within the context of the business environment.
